+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - 'work/a2-compute-browser-b4-parity*'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  id-token: write
+  attestations: write
+
+jobs:
+  b4-parity-gate:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout immutable source
+        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false

+          set -euo pipefail
+          node -e 'const m=Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]); if (m < 22) process.exit(1); console.log(process.version)'
+
+      - name: Static parse gate, full test suite, and B4/B5/B6 contracts
+        shell: bash
+        working-directory: coordination/browser-compute
+        timeout-minutes: 10
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          # Parse gate: rejects await-in-non-async-constructor SyntaxErrors and
+          # BOM-corrupted shebangs (both shipped unnoticed in 097a3b2 because
+          # no workflow triggered on this branch and AppVeyor runs no
+          # browser-compute tests).
+          find src tests -type f -name '*.mjs' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
+          # Full suite: must terminate on its own; an interval leak pins the
+          # event loop and this step fails on the timeout instead of green-hanging.
+          node --test tests/*.test.mjs
+          # B4 action/receipt parity contracts
+          grep -q "'action.navigate': 'ACTUATION'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "'action.click': 'ACTUATION'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "'action.type': 'ACTUATION'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "'action.submit': 'ACTUATION'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "'receipt.get': 'READ_ONLY'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "'receipt.verify': 'READ_ONLY'" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "authority_effect" ../browser-shared/receipt-contract.mjs
+          grep -q "hmac" ../browser-shared/lease-broker.mjs
+          # B5 local HTTP bridge + compute bridge manifest contracts
+          grep -q "compute-bridge.json" src/cli.mjs
+          grep -q "127.0.0.1" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          grep -q "dispatchRpc" src/rpc-server.mjs
+          # B6 node registry contracts + event-loop pin invariant
+          grep -q "unref" src/node-registry.mjs
+          grep -q "node_registry: true" src/cli.mjs
+          grep -q "NODE_HEALTH" ../browser-shared/node-registry.mjs
+          # Extension lease gate MUST be loaded by the MV3 service worker
+          # BEFORE operator-actions.js, otherwise lease enforcement no-ops.
+          grep -q 'importScripts("./operator-lease-gate.js");' ../chat-control-plane/extension/background-entry.js
+          grep -q "validateActionLease" ../chat-control-plane/extension/operator-lease-gate.js
+          grep -q "assertLeaseValid" ../chat-control-plane/extension/operator-actions.js
+          grep -q 'importScripts("./operator-compute-bridge.js");' ../chat-control-plane/extension/background-entry.js

+        working-directory: coordination/browser-compute
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export A2_COMPUTE_STATE_ROOT="$RUNNER_TEMP/a2-cb-b4-serve-state"

+          SERVE_PID=$!
+          cleanup() { kill -TERM "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }

+            [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/a2-cb-b4-serve-ready.json" ] && break

+            const ready = JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);
+            const assert = require("node:assert");
+            assert.equal(ready.schema, "metaengine.a2-compute-browser.ready.v1");
+            assert.equal(ready.node_registry, true);
+            assert.equal(ready.web_authority_effect, false);
+            assert.equal(ready.devtools_tcp_exposed, false);

+            -H "Authorization: Bearer definitely-not-the-token" \
+            -H 'content-type: application/json' \

+name: Amplifier Tournament
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - work/chat-control-plane-browser-bridge
+    paths:
+      - 'coordination/amplifier-loop/**'
+      - 'tests/test_chat_control_plane_bridge_contract.py'
+      - 'tests/test_a2_chat_bridge_receipt_contract.py'
+      - 'tests/test_a2_chat_bridge_remote_contract.py'
+      - '.github/workflows/amplifier-tournament.yml'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  pytest-xdist-canary:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact revision
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Install pinned free amplifier candidate
+        run: |
+          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check 'pytest==9.1.1' 'pytest-xdist==3.8.0'
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import pytest, xdist
+          assert pytest.__version__ == '9.1.1'
+          assert xdist.__version__ == '3.8.0'
+          PY
+
+      - name: Baseline vs pytest-xdist real-use tournament
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          import os
+          import statistics
+          import subprocess
+          import time
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          tests = [
+              'tests/test_chat_control_plane_bridge_contract.py',
+              'tests/test_a2_chat_bridge_receipt_contract.py',
+              'tests/test_a2_chat_bridge_remote_contract.py',
+          ]
+          baseline = ['python3', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', *tests]
+          candidate = ['python3', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-n', 'auto', *tests]
+
+          def run(command):
+              started = time.perf_counter()
+              proc = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
+              elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+              if proc.returncode != 0:
+                  print(proc.stdout)
+                  raise SystemExit(f'command failed: {command}')
+              return elapsed
+
+          # One warmup each keeps import/cache startup from dominating only one side.
+          run(baseline)
+          run(candidate)
+          baseline_samples = [run(baseline) for _ in range(5)]
+          candidate_samples = [run(candidate) for _ in range(5)]
+          baseline_median = statistics.median(baseline_samples)
+          candidate_median = statistics.median(candidate_samples)
+          speedup_ratio = baseline_median / candidate_median
+          verdict = 'ACCEPT' if candidate_median <= 0.95 * baseline_median else 'ROLLBACK'
+
+          record = {
+              'amplifier_id': 'pytest-xdist',
+              'candidate_version': '3.8.0',
+              'task_class': 'chat-control-python-contract',
+              'context_fingerprint': f"github-actions-ubuntu-24.04-py{os.sys.version_info.major}{os.sys.version_info.minor}-pytest9.1.1",
+              'baseline_metrics': {
+                  'command': 'python3 -m pytest -q <3 contract modules>',
+                  'median_wall_clock': baseline_median,
+                  'samples_seconds': baseline_samples,
+              },
+              'candidate_metrics': {
+                  'command': 'python3 -m pytest -q -n auto <3 contract modules>',
+                  'median_wall_clock': candidate_median,
+                  'samples_seconds': candidate_samples,
+              },
+              'correctness_pass': True,
+              'security_pass': True,
+              'zero_cost_pass': True,
+              'speedup_ratio': speedup_ratio,
+              'reliability_delta': 0.0,
+              'sample_count': 5,
+              'verdict': verdict,
+              'evidence_refs': [f"github-actions:{os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID', '')}"],
+              'rollback_instructions': 'Do not add -n auto to the required contract path if verdict is ROLLBACK.',
+          }
+          Path('amplifier-experiment.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
+          print('AMPLIFIER_RESULT=' + json.dumps({
+              'baseline_median': baseline_median,
+              'candidate_median': candidate_median,
+              'speedup_ratio': speedup_ratio,
+              'verdict': verdict,
+              'baseline_samples': baseline_samples,
+              'candidate_samples': candidate_samples,
+          }, sort_keys=True))
+          PY
+
+      - name: Feed measured record into strategy learner
+        run: |
+          CONTEXT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          record=json.loads(open('amplifier-experiment.jsonl').read())
+          print(record['context_fingerprint'])
+          PY
+          )
+          python3 coordination/amplifier-loop/learner.py amplifier-experiment.jsonl \
+            --task-class chat-control-python-contract \
+            --context-fingerprint "$CONTEXT" \
+            --output amplifier-strategy-hint.json
+          cat amplifier-strategy-hint.json
+
+      - name: Upload non-authority experiment evidence
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        with:
+          name: amplifier-pytest-xdist-experiment
+          path: |
+            amplifier-experiment.jsonl
+            amplifier-strategy-hint.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14

+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - 'work/browser-continuous-fleet-audit-v1'
+    paths:
+      - 'coordination/devos/branch-lineage-auditor.mjs'
+      - 'tests/branch_lineage_auditor.test.mjs'
+      - 'tests/branch_lineage_auditor_base_only.test.mjs'

+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'coordination/devos/branch-lineage-auditor.mjs'
+      - 'tests/branch_lineage_auditor.test.mjs'
+      - 'tests/branch_lineage_auditor_base_only.test.mjs'
+      - '.github/workflows/branch-lineage-audit-v1.yml'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  read-only-lineage-audit:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact candidate head
+        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Prove exact candidate head
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          ACTUAL_HEAD="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+          test "$ACTUAL_HEAD" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
+          printf 'exact_head=%s\n' "$ACTUAL_HEAD"
+
+      - name: Setup Node 24
+        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+
+      - name: Syntax and synthetic git-graph contract
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node --check coordination/devos/branch-lineage-auditor.mjs
+          node --test tests/branch_lineage_auditor.test.mjs tests/branch_lineage_auditor_base_only.test.mjs
+
+      - name: Fetch all public remote heads read-only
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git fetch --no-tags --force --prune origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'
+          COUNT="$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/origin/ | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
+          test "$COUNT" -gt 1
+          printf 'remote_head_count=%s\n' "$COUNT"
+
+      - name: Audit real repository branch lineages
+        env:
+          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/branch-lineage-audit-v1.json
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node coordination/devos/branch-lineage-auditor.mjs \
+            --base "$BASE_SHA" \
+            --namespace refs/remotes/origin/ \
+            --include '^(work|integration|release)/' \
+            --max-branches 1000 \
+            --max-files 200 \
+            --format json > "$OUT"
+          node --input-type=module - "$OUT" <<'NODE'
+          import fs from 'node:fs';
+          const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
+          if (report.schema !== 'metaengine.devos.branch-lineage-audit.v1') throw new Error('schema');
+          if (report.branch_count < 1) throw new Error('empty_audit');
+          if (report.authority_effect !== false || report.mutates_refs !== false || report.mutates_worktree !== false || report.invokes_scheduler !== false) {
+            throw new Error('read_only_contract');
+          }
+          const risky = report.branches.filter((row) => row.classification === 'DIVERGED_AUTHORITY').length;
+          const contained = report.branches.filter((row) => row.classification === 'CONTAINED').length;
+          console.log('LINEAGE_SUMMARY ' + JSON.stringify({
+            branch_count: report.branch_count,
+            authority_branch_count: report.authority_branch_count,
+            historical_authority_branch_count: report.historical_authority_branch_count,
+            semantic_converged_branch_count: report.semantic_converged_branch_count,
+            diverged_authority: risky,
+            contained,
+            lineage_tip_count: report.lineage_tip_count,
+            authority_lineage_tip_count: report.authority_lineage_tip_count,
+          }));
+          for (const row of report.top_authority_lineage_tips || []) {
+            console.log('LINEAGE_TIP ' + JSON.stringify({
+              branch: row.branch,
+              family: row.family,
+              classification: row.classification,
+              unique_commits: row.unique_commits,
+              base_only_commits: row.base_only_commits,
+              tip_delta_file_count: row.tip_delta_file_count,
+              authority_categories: row.authority_categories,
+            }));
+          }
+          for (const family of (report.family_summary || []).slice(0, 20)) {
+            console.log('LINEAGE_FAMILY ' + JSON.stringify(family));
+          }
+          NODE
+
+      - name: Prove audit did not mutate repository
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"

+name: METAENGINE Browser Final Runtime Activation V1
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - release/self-update-ambiguity-live-v2
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/src/**'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/test/final-runtime-activation-contract.test.mjs'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/package.json'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/electron-builder.test.json'
+      - '.github/workflows/browser-final-runtime-activation-v1.yml'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: browser-final-runtime-activation-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  windows-final-runtime-activation:
+    runs-on: windows-2025
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact candidate head
+        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Prove exact candidate head
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
+
+      - name: Setup Node 24
+        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+
+      - name: Install Browser dependencies
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock
+
+      - name: Parse activation and proven Browser sources
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: npm run check
+
+      - name: Prove activation contract and VEF fail-closed semantics
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: node --test test/final-runtime-activation-contract.test.mjs
+
+      - name: Build exact-head unsigned NSIS installer
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        env:
+          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $version = [string](node -p "require('./package.json').version")
+          if (-not $version) { throw 'package_version_missing' }
+          Remove-Item dist-test -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          Remove-Item native-dist\guardian -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          npx --yes electron-builder@26.15.7 --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.test.json --publish never
+          $installer = Get-ChildItem dist-test -Filter "METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-$version-x64.exe" -File | Select-Object -First 1
+          if (-not $installer) { throw 'final_runtime_installer_missing' }
+          Copy-Item $installer.FullName "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\$($installer.Name)"
+          Copy-Item $installer.FullName "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\final-runtime-candidate.exe"
+
+      - name: Install and prove all Final runtime modules READY
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $head = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
+          $version = [string](node -p "require('./package.json').version")
+          $installer = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\final-runtime-candidate.exe"
+          $install = Start-Process -FilePath $installer -ArgumentList '/S' -PassThru -Wait
+          if ($install.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "final_runtime_installer_exit_$($install.ExitCode)" }
+
+          $installRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\METAENGINE Browser Test'
+          $app = Join-Path $installRoot 'METAENGINE Browser Test.exe'
+          if (-not (Test-Path $app -PathType Leaf)) { throw "final_runtime_packaged_browser_missing:$app" }
+
+          $out = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\final-runtime-normal.out"
+          $err = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\final-runtime-normal.err"
+          Remove-Item $out,$err -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          $process = $null
+          $ready = $null
+          try {
+            $process = Start-Process -FilePath $app -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
+            $null = $process.Handle
+            $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(70)
+            while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) {
+              if ($process.HasExited) {
+                Get-Content $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+                Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+                throw "final_runtime_primary_exited_early:$($process.ExitCode)"
+              }
+              if (Test-Path $out -PathType Leaf) {
+                foreach ($line in @(Get-Content $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
+                  if (-not $line.Trim().StartsWith('{')) { continue }
+                  try { $row = $line | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
+                  if ($row.schema -eq 'metaengine.browser.final-runtime-activation.lifecycle.v1' -and $row.state -eq 'READY') {
+                    $ready = $row
+                    break
+                  }
+                }
+              }
+              if ($ready) { break }
+              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
+            }
+            if (-not $ready) {
+              Get-Content $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              throw 'final_runtime_activation_ready_not_observed'
+            }
+
+            $activation = $ready.activation
+            if (-not $activation) { throw 'final_runtime_activation_projection_missing' }
+            if ($activation.host_agent_state -ne 'READY') { throw "final_runtime_host_agent_not_ready:$($activation.host_agent_state)" }
+            if ($activation.signer_state -ne 'READY') { throw "final_runtime_signer_not_ready:$($activation.signer_state)" }
+            if ($activation.browser_execution_via_typed_ipc -ne $true) { throw 'final_runtime_typed_browser_executor_not_active' }
+            if ($activation.verified_execution_outcomes_active -ne $true) { throw 'final_runtime_vef_not_active' }
+            if ($activation.fast_control_read_side_active -ne $true) { throw 'final_runtime_fast_control_read_not_active' }
+            if ($activation.fast_control_production_mutation_authority -ne $false) { throw 'final_runtime_unproven_mutation_authority_enabled' }
+            if ($activation.production_authority_fabricated -ne $false) { throw 'final_runtime_production_authority_fabricated' }
+            if ($activation.second_scheduler -ne $false) { throw 'final_runtime_second_scheduler_detected' }
+            if ($activation.automatic_effect_retry_allowed -ne $false) { throw 'final_runtime_automatic_effect_retry_enabled' }
+
+            $installerFile = Get-Item $installer
+            $digest = (Get-FileHash $installerFile.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+            @{
+              schema='metaengine.browser.final-runtime-activation-proof.v1'
+              source_head=$head
+              package_version=$version
+              installer_sha256=$digest
+              activation=$activation
+              exact_head_verified=$true
+              installed_runtime_verified=$true
+              browser_identity_signer_active=$true
+              typed_browser_executor_active=$true
+              host_agent_active=$true
+              verified_execution_framework_active=$true
+              fast_control_read_side_active=$true
+              fast_control_production_mutation_authority=$false
+              native_supervisor_single_scheduler=$true
+              second_scheduler=$false
+              automatic_effect_retry_allowed=$false
+              signed=$false
+              published=$false
+              promotion_authorized=$false
+              authority_effect=$false
+            } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\final-runtime-activation-proof.json" -Encoding utf8
+            Write-Host ($ready | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10)
+          } finally {
+            if ($process -and -not $process.HasExited) {
+              try { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+            }
+          }
+
+      - name: Upload exact-head activated Windows installer and proof
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        with:
+          name: metaengine-browser-final-runtime-activated-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-*-x64.exe
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/final-runtime-activation-proof.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/final-runtime-normal.out
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/final-runtime-normal.err
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+
+      - name: Prove packaged Browser Node-host Compute path
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser

+          $stdoutPath = Join-Path $smokeRoot 'packaged-compute.out'

+          routes=Path('apps/metaengine-browser/supabase/a2-browser-native-supervisor-devos-routes.mjs').read_text()
+          migration=Path('supabase/migrations/20260831054300_devos_fleet_reconcile_v1.sql').read_text()
+          assert 'authenticateDevice' in edge
+          assert edge.index('authenticateDevice') < edge.index('devosRoutes({req,path,body,clientId:identity.id})')
+          assert "devos_fleet_reconcile_v1" in routes
+          assert routes.index("devos_fleet_reconcile_v1") < routes.index("devos_fleet_snapshot_v1")
+          assert "state = 'AMBIGUOUS'" in migration
+          assert "automatic_retry_allowed',false" in migration
+          assert "state = 'READY'" not in migration
+          PY

+  windows-rebuild:
+    needs: contracts
+    runs-on: windows-2022
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:

+          if (-not $exe) { throw 'installer_missing' }
+          $hash = (Get-FileHash $exe.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()

+      - name: Upload exact rebuilt Browser and evidence

+            browser-rebuild-evidence.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+          if (-not $profileLine) { throw 'installed_chat_profile_probe_output_missing' }

+          $normalErr = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\installed-chat-normal.err"
+          Remove-Item $normalOut,$normalErr -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          $normal = $null
+          try {
+            $normal = Start-Process -FilePath $app -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $normalOut -RedirectStandardError $normalErr
+            $null = $normal.Handle

+            $localShellIndex = -1
+            $preconnectIndex = -1
+            $userSessionIndex = -1
+            $nativeSupervisorIndex = -1
+            $initialTabIndex = -1
+            $remoteLoadIndex = -1

+                $normalLines = @(Get-Content $normalOut -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

+                $preconnectIndex = -1

+                $remoteLoadIndex = -1

+                      -and $runtimeEvent.state -eq 'SUBSYSTEM_READY' `
+                      -and $runtimeEvent.subsystem -eq 'USER_SESSION' `
+                      -and $runtimeEvent.authority_effect -eq $false) {
+                    $userSessionIndex = $i
+                  }
+                  if ($runtimeEvent.schema -eq 'metaengine.browser-startup-subsystem.v1' `
+                      -and $runtimeEvent.state -eq 'SUBSYSTEM_READY' `
+                      -and $runtimeEvent.subsystem -eq 'NATIVE_SUPERVISOR' `

+                    -and $controlState.armed -eq $true `
+                    -and $controlState.authority_effect -eq $false `

+
+            if ($localShellIndex -lt 0) { throw 'installed_local_shell_not_visible' }
+            if ($preconnectIndex -lt 0) { throw 'installed_chatgpt_preconnect_not_armed' }

+            if (-not $cleanControl) { throw 'installed_clean_genesis_control_not_verified' }
+            if ($initialTabIndex -ge 0) { throw 'installed_clean_genesis_created_initial_tab' }

+            $proof.preconnect_armed = $true
+            $proof.clean_genesis_control_verified = $true

+          } finally {

+              cmd.exe /d /c "taskkill.exe /PID $($normal.Id) /T /F >nul 2>&1 & exit /b 0" | Out-Null

+
+      - name: Prove exact source checkout unchanged
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+            ${{ runner.temp }}/installed-chat-normal.out

+name: Browser Windows Package Smoke
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - 'work/browser-continuous-fleet-audit-v1'
+      - 'release/self-update-ambiguity-live-v2'
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/src/**'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/ui/**'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/native/**'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/scripts/build-guardian-native-staging.ps1'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/scripts/electron-builder-before-pack.cjs'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/scripts/verify-installed-guardian-native-staging.ps1'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/test/browser-startup-observability.test.mjs'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/test/browser-shell-visual-evidence.mjs'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/package.json'
+      - 'apps/metaengine-browser/electron-builder.test.json'
+      - '.github/workflows/browser-windows-package-smoke.yml'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: browser-windows-package-smoke-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  windows-nsis-package-smoke:
+    runs-on: windows-2025
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout exact candidate head
+        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Prove exact candidate head
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
+
+      - name: Setup Node 24
+        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+
+      - name: Install test-package dependencies
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock
+
+      - name: Parse exact source before packaging
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: npm run check
+
+      - name: Prove startup observability reducer before packaging
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        run: node --test test/browser-startup-observability.test.mjs
+
+      - name: Capture deterministic shell-only visual evidence
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        env:
+          METAENGINE_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}\browser-shell-visual
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          node --check test/browser-shell-visual-evidence.mjs
+          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:METAENGINE_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_DIR | Out-Null
+          & .\node_modules\.bin\electron.cmd .\test\browser-shell-visual-evidence.mjs
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "visual_evidence_electron_exit_$LASTEXITCODE" }
+          $evidencePath = Join-Path $env:METAENGINE_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_DIR 'visual-evidence.json'
+          if (-not (Test-Path $evidencePath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'visual_evidence_json_missing' }
+          $evidence = Get-Content $evidencePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($evidence.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-shell.visual-evidence.v1') { throw 'visual_evidence_schema_invalid' }
+          if ($evidence.shell_only_capture -ne $true -or $evidence.remote_browser_content_captured -ne $false) { throw 'visual_evidence_scope_invalid' }
+          if ($evidence.golden_comparison_enabled -ne $false -or $evidence.authority_effect -ne $false) { throw 'visual_evidence_authority_invalid' }
+          if ($evidence.route_reset.command_mode -ne 'CMD' -or $evidence.route_reset.restored_mode -ne 'CHAT' -or $evidence.route_reset.restored_chat_class -ne $true) { throw 'visual_evidence_route_reset_invalid' }
+          if (@($evidence.captures).Count -ne 2) { throw 'visual_evidence_capture_count_invalid' }
+          foreach ($capture in @($evidence.captures)) {
+            if ($capture.metrics.systems_visible -ne $true) { throw "visual_evidence_health_hidden:$($capture.name)" }
+            if ([int64]$capture.bytes -lt 4096 -or -not [string]$capture.sha256) { throw "visual_evidence_png_invalid:$($capture.name)" }
+            $pngPath = Join-Path $env:METAENGINE_VISUAL_EVIDENCE_DIR ([string]$capture.file)
+            if (-not (Test-Path $pngPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "visual_evidence_png_missing:$($capture.name)" }
+          }
+          Write-Host ($evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 8)
+
+      - name: Build exact-head unsigned NSIS package through native staging hook
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        env:
+          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
+        run: |
+          $sourceHead = '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}'
+          $version = [string](node -p "require('./package.json').version")
+          if (-not $version) { throw 'package_version_missing' }
+          Remove-Item dist-test -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          Remove-Item native-dist\guardian -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          npx --yes electron-builder@26.15.7 --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.test.json --publish never
+          $installer = Get-ChildItem dist-test -Filter "METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-$version-x64.exe" -File | Select-Object -First 1
+          $blockmap = Get-ChildItem dist-test -Filter "METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-$version-x64.exe.blockmap" -File | Select-Object -First 1
+          if (-not $installer -or -not $blockmap) { throw 'package_assets_missing' }
+          $stagedManifest = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'native-dist\guardian\guardian-native-manifest.json'
+          if (-not (Test-Path $stagedManifest -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'before_pack_guardian_staging_not_materialized' }
+          $digest = (Get-FileHash $installer.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+          @{
+            schema='metaengine.browser.windows-package-smoke.v3'
+            source_head=$sourceHead
+            package_version=$version
+            installer_name=$installer.Name
+            installer_sha256=$digest
+            blockmap_name=$blockmap.Name
+            guardian_native_staging_required=$true
+            guardian_native_built_by_before_pack=$true
+            version_probe_verified=$false
+            normal_ui_boot_verified=$false
+            runtime_import_observability_verified=$false
+            second_instance_activation_verified=$false
+            signed=$false
+            published=$false
+            promotion_authorized=$false
+            authority_effect=$false
+          } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\windows-package-proof.json" -Encoding utf8
+          Copy-Item $installer.FullName "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\candidate-setup.exe"
+          Copy-Item $installer.FullName (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP $installer.Name)
+
+      - name: Install exact-head package and prove Browser plus inert Guardian payload
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $proofPath = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\windows-package-proof.json"
+          $proof = Get-Content $proofPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if (Get-Service -Name 'METAENGINEBrowserGuardian' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'guardian_service_preexists_before_package_install' }
+          $install = Start-Process -FilePath "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\candidate-setup.exe" -ArgumentList '/S' -PassThru -Wait
+          if ($install.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "package_installer_exit_$($install.ExitCode)" }
+
+          $guardianLine = (& ./scripts/verify-installed-guardian-native-staging.ps1 `
+            -ExpectedSourceHead ([string]$proof.source_head) `
+            -ExpectedPackageVersion ([string]$proof.package_version) | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1)
+          if (-not $guardianLine) { throw 'guardian_installed_staging_proof_missing' }
+          $guardian = $guardianLine | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($guardian.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser.guardian-native-installed-staging-proof.v1') { throw 'guardian_installed_staging_proof_schema_invalid' }
+          if ([string]$guardian.package_version -ne [string]$proof.package_version) { throw 'guardian_installed_staging_version_drift' }
+          if ($guardian.guardian_service_absent -ne $true -or $guardian.staging_only -ne $true -or $guardian.service_activation_authorized -ne $false) { throw 'guardian_installed_staging_proof_invalid' }
+
+          $installRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\METAENGINE Browser Test'
+          $app = Join-Path $installRoot 'METAENGINE Browser Test.exe'
+          if (-not (Test-Path $app)) { throw "packaged_browser_missing:$app" }
+          $out = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-version-probe.out"
+          $err = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-version-probe.err"
+          $probe = Start-Process -FilePath $app -ArgumentList '--metaengine-version-probe' -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err
+          $null = $probe.Handle
+          if (-not $probe.WaitForExit(15000)) {
+            try { Stop-Process -Id $probe.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+            throw 'package_version_probe_timeout'
+          }
+          if ($probe.ExitCode -ne 0) {
+            Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+            throw "package_version_probe_exit_$($probe.ExitCode)"
+          }
+          $row = (Get-Content $out | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1) | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ([string]$row.version -ne [string]$proof.package_version -or $row.primary_instance -ne $true) { throw 'package_version_probe_mismatch' }
+          $proof.version_probe_verified = $true
+
+          if ($proof.guardian_native_built_by_before_pack -ne $true) { throw 'guardian_before_pack_proof_missing' }
+          if ($proof.signed -ne $false -or $proof.published -ne $false -or $proof.promotion_authorized -ne $false -or $proof.authority_effect -ne $false) { throw 'package_zero_authority_contract_invalid' }
+          $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName guardian_native_manifest_sha256 -NotePropertyValue ([string]$guardian.manifest_sha256) -Force
+          $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName guardian_native_staging_verified -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
+          $proof | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $proofPath -Encoding utf8
+          Write-Host ($proof | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
+
+      - name: Prove normal packaged UI boot and second-instance activation
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $proofPath = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\windows-package-proof.json"
+          $proof = Get-Content $proofPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+          $installRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\METAENGINE Browser Test'
+          $app = Join-Path $installRoot 'METAENGINE Browser Test.exe'
+          if (-not (Test-Path $app -PathType Leaf)) { throw "packaged_browser_missing:$app" }
+
+          # Never guess Electron's packaged userData directory from productName.
+          # Ask the exact installed binary for app.getPath('userData') through
+          # the existing read-only profile probe, then bind every journal read
+          # to that exact path. The write flag creates only the probe marker that
+          # this pre-existing contract requires; it does not bypass normal boot.
+          $profileOut = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-profile-probe.out"
+          $profileErr = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-profile-probe.err"
+          Remove-Item $profileOut,$profileErr -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          $priorProfileWrite = $env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE
+          $env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE = '1'
+          try {
+            $profileProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $app -ArgumentList '--metaengine-profile-probe' -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $profileOut -RedirectStandardError $profileErr
+            $null = $profileProcess.Handle
+            if (-not $profileProcess.WaitForExit(15000)) {
+              try { Stop-Process -Id $profileProcess.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+              throw 'package_profile_probe_timeout'
+            }
+            if ($profileProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) {
+              Get-Content $profileErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              throw "package_profile_probe_exit_$($profileProcess.ExitCode)"
+            }
+          } finally {
+            $env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE = $priorProfileWrite
+          }
+          $profileLine = Get-Content $profileOut | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1
+          if (-not $profileLine) { throw 'package_profile_probe_output_missing' }
+          $profile = $profileLine | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($profile.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser.profile-probe.v1' `
+              -or [string]$profile.version -ne [string]$proof.package_version `
+              -or $profile.primary_instance -ne $true `
+              -or $profile.marker_present -ne $true `
+              -or -not [string]$profile.user_data_path) {
+            $profile | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Write-Host
+            throw 'package_profile_probe_contract_invalid'
+          }
+          $userData = [string]$profile.user_data_path
+          if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($userData)) { throw 'package_profile_user_data_not_absolute' }
+          $journal = Join-Path $userData 'metaengine-browser-startup-journal-v1.json'
+          $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName user_data_path -NotePropertyValue $userData -Force
+          $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName user_data_path_source -NotePropertyValue 'PACKAGED_PROFILE_PROBE' -Force
+          $proof | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $proofPath -Encoding utf8
+
+          $normalOut = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-normal-ui.out"
+          $normalErr = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-normal-ui.err"
+          $secondOut = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-second-instance.out"
+          $secondErr = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\package-second-instance.err"
+          Remove-Item $journal -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          Remove-Item "$journal.corrupt-*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          Remove-Item $normalOut,$normalErr,$secondOut,$secondErr -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+
+          $normal = $null
+          try {
+            # No probe/smoke flag is allowed here. This must exercise the same
+            # main-entry path a user launches from Explorer/Start Menu.
+            $normal = Start-Process -FilePath $app -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $normalOut -RedirectStandardError $normalErr
+            $null = $normal.Handle
+            $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(55)
+            $stableEvent = $null
+            while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline) {
+              if ($normal.HasExited) {
+                Get-Content $normalErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+                throw "normal_ui_primary_exited_early:$($normal.ExitCode)"
+              }
+              if (Test-Path $journal -PathType Leaf) {
+                try {
+                  $startup = Get-Content $journal -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+                  if ($startup.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser.startup-journal.v1') { throw 'normal_ui_startup_journal_schema_invalid' }
+                  $importFailure = @($startup.events | Where-Object { $_.boot_id -eq $startup.current_boot_id -and $_.state -eq 'RUNTIME_IMPORT_FAILED' } | Select-Object -Last 1)
+                  if ($importFailure.Count -gt 0) {
+                    $importFailure | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Write-Host
+                    Get-Content $normalErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+                    throw 'normal_ui_runtime_import_failed'
+                  }
+                  $stableEvent = $startup.events | Where-Object { $_.boot_id -eq $startup.current_boot_id -and $_.state -eq 'PRIMARY_WINDOW_STABLE' } | Select-Object -Last 1
+                  if ($stableEvent) { break }
+                } catch {
+                  if ($_.Exception.Message -eq 'normal_ui_runtime_import_failed') { throw }
+                }
+              }
+              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
+              $normal.Refresh()
+            }
+            if (-not $stableEvent) {
+              Get-Content $normalErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              if (Test-Path $journal) { Get-Content $journal -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Write-Host }
+              throw 'normal_ui_stable_window_timeout'
+            }
+
+            $startup = Get-Content $journal -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+            $runtimeImport = $startup.events | Where-Object { $_.boot_id -eq $startup.current_boot_id -and $_.state -eq 'RUNTIME_IMPORT_OK' } | Select-Object -Last 1
+            if (-not $runtimeImport) { throw 'normal_ui_runtime_import_success_evidence_missing' }
+            if ($stableEvent.details.visible -ne $true) { throw 'normal_ui_stable_window_not_visible' }
+            $stableSequence = [int64]$stableEvent.sequence
+
+            # A second ordinary launch must not create a second fleet/runtime.
+            # Electron forwards it to the primary, which must show/restore/focus
+            # the already-created BaseWindow and record exact-nonce activation.
+            $second = Start-Process -FilePath $app -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $secondOut -RedirectStandardError $secondErr
+            $null = $second.Handle
+            if (-not $second.WaitForExit(18000)) {
+              try { Stop-Process -Id $second.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+              throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_did_not_exit'
+            }
+            if ($second.ExitCode -ne 0) {
+              Get-Content $secondErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              throw "normal_ui_second_instance_exit_$($second.ExitCode)"
+            }
+            $secondaryLine = Get-Content $secondOut | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1
+            if (-not $secondaryLine) { throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_ack_output_missing' }
+            $secondaryAck = $secondaryLine | ConvertFrom-Json
+            if ($secondaryAck.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser.secondary-launch.v1' `
+                -or $secondaryAck.state -ne 'PRIMARY_UI_ACTIVATION_ACKNOWLEDGED' `
+                -or -not [string]$secondaryAck.launch_id `
+                -or $secondaryAck.second_browser_runtime_started -ne $false `
+                -or $secondaryAck.authority_effect -ne $false) {
+              $secondaryAck | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Write-Host
+              throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_ack_contract_invalid'
+            }
+
+            $activationDeadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(12)
+            $activation = $null
+            while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $activationDeadline) {
+              $startup = Get-Content $journal -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+              $activation = $startup.events | Where-Object {
+                $_.boot_id -eq $startup.current_boot_id `
+                  -and $_.state -eq 'PRIMARY_WINDOW_ACTIVATED' `
+                  -and [int64]$_.sequence -gt $stableSequence `
+                  -and $_.details.launch_id -eq [string]$secondaryAck.launch_id
+              } | Select-Object -Last 1
+              if ($activation) { break }
+              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
+            }
+            if (-not $activation) {
+              Get-Content $journal -Raw | Write-Host
+              Get-Content $secondOut -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              Get-Content $secondErr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+              throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_activation_missing'
+            }
+            if ($activation.details.visible -ne $true) { throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_window_not_visible' }
+            if ([int64]$secondaryAck.event_sequence -ne [int64]$activation.sequence) { throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_ack_sequence_drift' }
+            if ([int64]$secondaryAck.primary_pid -ne [int64]$activation.pid) { throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_ack_pid_drift' }
+            if ([string]$secondaryAck.primary_version -ne [string]$activation.version) { throw 'normal_ui_second_instance_ack_version_drift' }
+
+            $normal.Refresh()
+            if ($normal.HasExited) { throw 'normal_ui_primary_died_after_second_instance' }
+
+            # Live 0.7.0-dev.2.1 repeatedly crossed the Sentinel's 180-second
+            # startup grace and relaunched a healthy parent. Bind the exact
+            # packaged process, Sentinel token/boot and useful-progress lease,
+            # then stay alive beyond that boundary with no recovery generation.
+            $sentinelPath = Join-Path $userData 'metaengine-browser-sentinel-v1.json'
+            $progressPath = "$sentinelPath.parent-progress-v1.json"
+            $workerHeartbeatPath = "$sentinelPath.worker-heartbeat-v1.json"
+            $sentinelDeadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(35)
+            $sentinelBefore = $null
+            $progressBefore = $null
+            $workerHeartbeatBefore = $null
+            while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $sentinelDeadline) {
+              try {
+                if ((Test-Path $sentinelPath -PathType Leaf) `
+                    -and (Test-Path $progressPath -PathType Leaf) `
+                    -and (Test-Path $workerHeartbeatPath -PathType Leaf)) {
+                  $sentinelBefore = Get-Content $sentinelPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+                  $progressBefore = Get-Content $progressPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+                  $workerHeartbeatBefore = Get-Content $workerHeartbeatPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+                  if ($sentinelBefore.schema -eq 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.state.v1' `
+                      -and [int64]$sentinelBefore.parent_pid -eq [int64]$normal.Id `
+                      -and [int64]$sentinelBefore.worker_pid -gt 0 `
+                      -and $sentinelBefore.worker_released -eq $false `
+                      -and $progressBefore.schema -eq 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.parent-progress.v1' `
+                      -and [string]$progressBefore.token -eq [string]$sentinelBefore.token `
+                      -and [int64]$progressBefore.parent_pid -eq [int64]$normal.Id `
+                      -and $workerHeartbeatBefore.schema -eq 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.worker-heartbeat.v1' `
+                      -and [string]$workerHeartbeatBefore.token -eq [string]$sentinelBefore.token `
+                      -and [int64]$workerHeartbeatBefore.parent_pid -eq [int64]$normal.Id `
+                      -and [int64]$workerHeartbeatBefore.worker_pid -eq [int64]$sentinelBefore.worker_pid `
+                      -and $workerHeartbeatBefore.lifecycle -eq 'READY') { break }
+                }
+              } catch {}
+              $sentinelBefore = $null
+              $progressBefore = $null
+              $workerHeartbeatBefore = $null
+              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
+            }
+            if (-not $sentinelBefore -or -not $progressBefore -or -not $workerHeartbeatBefore) { throw 'normal_ui_sentinel_progress_binding_missing' }
+            $sentinelToken = [string]$sentinelBefore.token
+            $sentinelCreatedAt = [string]$sentinelBefore.created_at
+            $sentinelWorkerPid = [int64]$sentinelBefore.worker_pid
+            $recoveryGeneration = [int64]$sentinelBefore.worker_recovery_generation
+            $progressSequence = [int64]$progressBefore.progress_seq
+
+            Start-Sleep -Seconds 190
+            $normal.Refresh()
+            if ($normal.HasExited) { throw 'normal_ui_primary_died_across_sentinel_startup_grace' }
+            $startupAfter = Get-Content $journal -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+            $sentinelAfter = Get-Content $sentinelPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+            $progressAfter = Get-Content $progressPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+            $workerHeartbeatAfter = Get-Content $workerHeartbeatPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+            if ([string]$startupAfter.current_boot_id -ne [string]$startup.current_boot_id) { throw 'normal_ui_boot_id_changed_across_sentinel_startup_grace' }
+            if ($sentinelAfter.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.state.v1' `
+                -or [string]$sentinelAfter.token -ne $sentinelToken `
+                -or [string]$sentinelAfter.created_at -ne $sentinelCreatedAt `
+                -or [int64]$sentinelAfter.parent_pid -ne [int64]$normal.Id `
+                -or [int64]$sentinelAfter.worker_pid -ne $sentinelWorkerPid `
+                -or $sentinelAfter.worker_released -ne $false `
+                -or $sentinelAfter.relaunch_attempted -ne $false `
+                -or [int64]$sentinelAfter.worker_recovery_generation -ne $recoveryGeneration) {
+              throw 'normal_ui_sentinel_identity_or_recovery_drift'
+            }
+            if ($workerHeartbeatAfter.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.worker-heartbeat.v1' `
+                -or [string]$workerHeartbeatAfter.token -ne $sentinelToken `
+                -or [int64]$workerHeartbeatAfter.parent_pid -ne [int64]$normal.Id `
+                -or [int64]$workerHeartbeatAfter.worker_pid -ne $sentinelWorkerPid `
+                -or $workerHeartbeatAfter.lifecycle -ne 'READY') {
+              throw 'normal_ui_sentinel_worker_heartbeat_binding_drift'
+            }
+            $workerHeartbeatAgeSeconds = ([DateTime]::UtcNow - ([DateTime]::Parse([string]$workerHeartbeatAfter.heartbeat_at)).ToUniversalTime()).TotalSeconds
+            if ($workerHeartbeatAgeSeconds -lt 0 -or $workerHeartbeatAgeSeconds -gt 15) { throw "normal_ui_sentinel_worker_heartbeat_stale:$workerHeartbeatAgeSeconds" }
+            if ($progressAfter.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-sentinel.parent-progress.v1' `
+                -or [string]$progressAfter.token -ne $sentinelToken `
+                -or [int64]$progressAfter.parent_pid -ne [int64]$normal.Id `
+                -or [int64]$progressAfter.progress_seq -le $progressSequence) {
+              throw 'normal_ui_parent_progress_did_not_advance'
+            }
+            $progressAgeSeconds = ([DateTime]::UtcNow - ([DateTime]::Parse([string]$progressAfter.progress_at)).ToUniversalTime()).TotalSeconds
+            if ($progressAgeSeconds -lt 0 -or $progressAgeSeconds -gt 30) { throw "normal_ui_parent_progress_stale:$progressAgeSeconds" }
+
+            Copy-Item $journal "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\browser-startup-journal-v1.json" -Force
+            Copy-Item $sentinelPath "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\browser-sentinel-v1.json" -Force
+            Copy-Item $progressPath "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\browser-parent-progress-v1.json" -Force
+            Copy-Item $workerHeartbeatPath "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\browser-sentinel-worker-heartbeat-v1.json" -Force
+            $proof.normal_ui_boot_verified = $true
+            $proof.runtime_import_observability_verified = $true
+            $proof.second_instance_activation_verified = $true
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName startup_grace_survival_seconds -NotePropertyValue 190 -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName same_primary_pid_across_startup_grace -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName same_sentinel_token_across_startup_grace -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName parent_progress_advanced_across_startup_grace -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName sentinel_relaunch_attempted -NotePropertyValue $false -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName startup_journal_schema -NotePropertyValue 'metaengine.browser.startup-journal.v1' -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName normal_ui_stable_event_sequence -NotePropertyValue ([int64]$stableEvent.sequence) -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName second_instance_activation_event_sequence -NotePropertyValue ([int64]$activation.sequence) -Force
+            $proof | Add-Member -NotePropertyName second_instance_launch_id -NotePropertyValue ([string]$secondaryAck.launch_id) -Force
+            $proof | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $proofPath -Encoding utf8
+            Write-Host ($proof | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
+          } finally {
+            if ($normal -and -not $normal.HasExited) {
+              # Cleanup is not evidence. Native taskkill can return 1 when a child
+              # exits between enumeration and termination even after the primary
+              # was terminated. Preserve /T tree cleanup but force cleanup-only
+              # exit status to zero so it cannot invalidate completed UI proof.
+              cmd.exe /d /c "taskkill.exe /PID $($normal.Id) /T /F >nul 2>&1 & exit /b 0" | Out-Null
+            }
+          }
+
+      - name: Prove source checkout unchanged
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+
+      - name: Upload exact-head Windows candidate and startup evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        with:
+          name: metaengine-browser-windows-candidate-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-*-x64.exe
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/windows-package-proof.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-startup-journal-v1.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-sentinel-v1.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-parent-progress-v1.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-sentinel-worker-heartbeat-v1.json

+            ${{ runner.temp }}/package-profile-probe.err
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/package-normal-ui.out
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/package-normal-ui.err
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/package-second-instance.out
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/package-second-instance.err
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-shell-visual/visual-evidence.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-shell-visual/*.png
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30

+          grep -q "automatic_retry_allowed: false" "$FILE"
+          grep -q "scheduler_authority: false" "$FILE"
+          grep -q "browser_actuation_authority: false" "$FILE"

+          grep -q "reconciled_from_durable_receipt" "$SQL"
+          grep -q "workspace_reincarnation_transition_id_collision" "$REPLAY"
+          grep -q "predecessor_workspace_generation <> p_expected_workspace_generation" "$REPLAY"
+          grep -q "successor_claim_id <> p_successor_claim_id" "$REPLAY"

+          ! grep -Eq "setInterval\s*\(|setTimeout\s*\(|fetch\s*\(|ipcRenderer|webContents\.(click|sendInputEvent)|child_process|exec\s*\(|spawn\s*\(" "$FILE"
+          ! grep -Eq "\burl\s*:|\btitle\s*:|page_text|model_text|prompt\s*:" "$FILE"
+          ! grep -Eqi "execute[[:space:]]+format|task_spec|page_text|model_text|prompt_text" "$SQL" "$REPLAY"
+
+      - name: Clean checkout
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
+          printf 'production_db_mutation=false\n'
+          printf 'browser_actuation=false\n'
+          printf 'transport_promotion_by_reincarnation=false\n'
+          printf 'second_scheduler=false\n'

+

+          $builder = Get-Content ./electron-builder.test.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($builder.nsis.runAfterFinish -ne $true) { throw 'nsis_run_after_finish_not_enabled' }
+          $runtime = Get-Content ./src/self-update-runtime-v8.mjs -Raw
+          if ($runtime -notmatch 'quitAndInstall\(true,\s*true\)') { throw 'self_update_force_run_after_install_contract_missing' }
+          $handoff = Get-Content ./src/self-update-handoff.mjs -Raw
+          if ($handoff -notmatch "receipt\?\.successor_startup\s*\|\|\s*SUCCESSOR_STARTUP_NORMAL") { throw 'self_update_normal_successor_default_missing' }
+          $bootstrap = Get-Content ./scripts/bootstrap-install-and-launch.ps1 -Raw
+          if ($bootstrap -notmatch "bootstrap_launch_kind = 'POST_INSTALL_NORMAL'") { throw 'bootstrap_post_install_normal_launch_contract_missing' }
+          if ($bootstrap -notmatch 'PRIMARY_WINDOW_STABLE') { throw 'bootstrap_visible_window_physical_gate_missing' }
+
+      - name: Build exact Windows NSIS candidate
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $version = [string](node -p "require('./package.json').version")
+          if ($version -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+-dev\.\d+\.1$') { throw "package_version_not_trusted_dev_shape:$version" }
+          Remove-Item dist-test -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+          $env:CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY = 'false'
+          npx --yes electron-builder@26.15.7 --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.test.json --publish never
+          $installer = Get-ChildItem dist-test -Filter "METAENGINE-Browser-Test-Setup-$version-x64.exe" -File | Select-Object -First 1
+          if (-not $installer) { throw 'bootstrap_candidate_installer_missing' }
+          $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $installer.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
+          if ($hash -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') { throw 'bootstrap_candidate_installer_sha256_invalid' }
+          "METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_VERSION=$version" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
+          "METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_INSTALLER=$($installer.FullName)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
+          "METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_INSTALLER_SHA256=$hash" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
+
+      - name: Install exact candidate and prove automatic visible Browser launch
+        working-directory: apps/metaengine-browser
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          $proofPath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'bootstrap-autostart-proof.json'

+            -ExpectedInstallerSha256 $env:METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_INSTALLER_SHA256 `
+            -ExpectedVersion $env:METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_VERSION `
+            -ProofPath $proofPath `

+          $proof = Get-Content -LiteralPath $proofPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+          if ($proof.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser.bootstrap-install-autostart-proof.v1') { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_proof_schema_invalid' }
+          if ([string]$proof.expected_version -ne $env:METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_VERSION) { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_version_drift' }
+          if ([string]$proof.installer_sha256 -ne $env:METAENGINE_BOOTSTRAP_INSTALLER_SHA256) { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_installer_digest_drift' }
+          if ($proof.install_exit_code -ne 0 -or $proof.automatic_browser_launch_performed -ne $true -or $proof.browser_visible -ne $true) { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_effect_not_proven' }
+          if ($proof.runtime_import_verified -ne $true -or $proof.version_probe_verified -ne $true) { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_runtime_binding_not_proven' }
+          if ([string]$proof.bootstrap_launch_kind -ne 'POST_INSTALL_NORMAL' -or $proof.authority_effect -ne $false) { throw 'bootstrap_autostart_launch_contract_invalid' }
+          $proof | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Write-Host

+      - name: Upload bootstrap autostart evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
+        with:
+          name: metaengine-browser-bootstrap-autostart-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/bootstrap-autostart-proof.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          compression-level: 0
+
+      - name: Cleanup Browser process
+        if: always()
+        shell: powershell
+        run: |
+          $app = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\METAENGINE Browser Test\METAENGINE Browser Test.exe'
+          Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {
+            try { [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$_.Path) -eq [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($app) } catch { $false }
+          } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

+            if [ -s e2e-run-id.txt ]; then break; fi

+          python3 - <<'PY'

+          rows=json.load(open('artifacts.json','r',encoding='utf-8')).get('artifacts',[])
+          rows=[a for a in rows if a.get('name','').startswith('metaengine-browser-self-update-e2e-') and not a.get('expired',False)]
+          if len(rows)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'exact_e2e_artifact_cardinality_invalid:{len(rows)}')

+          if any(m.get(k) is not True for k in required_true): raise SystemExit('manifest_physical_gate_incomplete')
+          version=str(m.get('version') or '')

+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "${GITHUB_REF}" = 'refs/heads/integration/metaengine-development-os-v1'

+          test -n "${ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN:-}"
+
+          oidc_json="$(curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \

+            --data '{}' \
+            "$ENDPOINT")"

+          [[ "$CANDIDATE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]

+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p sandbox-out
+          chmod 0777 sandbox-out
+          set +e
+          docker run --rm \
+            --network none \
+            --read-only \
+            --cap-drop ALL \
+            --security-opt no-new-privileges \
+            --pids-limit 64 \
+            --memory 512m \
+            --cpus 1 \
+            --user 65534:65534 \
+            --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=64m \

+param(
+  [string]$OutputDir = (Join-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) 'native-dist\guardian')
+)
+
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+
+$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path
+$sourceDir = Join-Path $root 'native\browser-guardian-scm'
+$serviceSource = Join-Path $sourceDir 'browser-guardian-scm-service.cpp'
+$actuatorSource = Join-Path $sourceDir 'browser-guardian-update-actuator.cpp'
+$ownerObserverSource = Join-Path $sourceDir 'browser-guardian-owner-enrollment-observer.cpp'
+$ownerStoreSource = Join-Path $sourceDir 'browser-guardian-owner-enrollment-store.cpp'
+$configuratorSource = Join-Path $sourceDir 'browser-guardian-scm-configure.cpp'
+foreach ($path in @($serviceSource,$actuatorSource,$ownerObserverSource,$ownerStoreSource,$configuratorSource)) {
+  if (-not (Test-Path $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "guardian_native_source_missing:$path" }
+}
+
+$vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
+if (-not (Test-Path $vswhere)) { throw 'vswhere_missing' }
+$vsRoot = (& $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath | Select-Object -First 1)
+if (-not $vsRoot) { throw 'visual_studio_cpp_toolchain_missing' }
+$vcvars = Join-Path $vsRoot 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'
+if (-not (Test-Path $vcvars)) { throw 'vcvars64_missing' }
+
+$resolvedOut = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutputDir)
+Remove-Item $resolvedOut -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resolvedOut -Force | Out-Null
+
+$service = Join-Path $resolvedOut 'METAENGINEBrowserGuardian.exe'
+$configurator = Join-Path $resolvedOut 'METAENGINEBrowserGuardianConfigure.exe'
+$serviceCmd = 'call "{0}" >nul && cl.exe /nologo /std:c++20 /EHsc /W4 /WX /DUNICODE /D_UNICODE "{1}" "{2}" "{3}" "{4}" /Fe:"{5}" /link advapi32.lib bcrypt.lib shell32.lib ole32.lib userenv.lib wtsapi32.lib' -f $vcvars,$serviceSource,$actuatorSource,$ownerObserverSource,$ownerStoreSource,$service
+& $env:ComSpec /d /s /c $serviceCmd
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "guardian_service_compile_exit_$LASTEXITCODE" }
+$configCmd = 'call "{0}" >nul && cl.exe /nologo /std:c++20 /EHsc /W4 /WX /DUNICODE /D_UNICODE "{1}" /Fe:"{2}" /link advapi32.lib shell32.lib ole32.lib' -f $vcvars,$configuratorSource,$configurator
+& $env:ComSpec /d /s /c $configCmd
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "guardian_configurator_compile_exit_$LASTEXITCODE" }
+
+$actuatorContractRaw = (& $service --update-actuator-contract-json | Out-String).Trim()
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "guardian_update_actuator_contract_exit_$LASTEXITCODE" }
+$actuatorContract = $actuatorContractRaw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($actuatorContract.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-guardian.update-actuator.v1' `
+    -or $actuatorContract.native_write_ahead_effect_barrier -ne $true `
+    -or $actuatorContract.at_most_one_dispatch_per_effect_id -ne $true `
+    -or $actuatorContract.caller_supplied_path_allowed -ne $false `
+    -or $actuatorContract.caller_supplied_url_allowed -ne $false `
+    -or $actuatorContract.caller_supplied_shell_allowed -ne $false `
+    -or $actuatorContract.automatic_retry_allowed -ne $false) {
+  throw 'guardian_update_actuator_contract_invalid'
+}
+$actuatorSelfTestRaw = (& $service --update-actuator-self-test | Out-String).Trim()
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "guardian_update_actuator_self_test_exit_$LASTEXITCODE" }
+$actuatorSelfTest = $actuatorSelfTestRaw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($actuatorSelfTest.schema -ne 'metaengine.browser-guardian.update-actuator-self-test.v1' -or $actuatorSelfTest.ok -ne $true) {
+  throw 'guardian_update_actuator_self_test_invalid'
+}
+
+$sourceHead = (git -C $root rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
+if ($sourceHead -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw "guardian_staging_source_head_invalid:$sourceHead" }
+$packageJsonPath = Join-Path $root 'package.json'
+if (-not (Test-Path $packageJsonPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'guardian_staging_package_json_missing' }
+$packageVersion = [string]((Get-Content $packageJsonPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version)
+if (-not $packageVersion) { throw 'guardian_staging_package_version_missing' }
+
+$binaries = @()
+foreach ($item in @(
+  @{ path=$service; role='scm_service_host_with_bounded_update_actuator'; activationTool=$false },

+)) {
+  if (-not (Test-Path $item.path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "guardian_native_binary_missing:$($item.path)" }
+  $file = Get-Item $item.path

+  if ($sha -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw "guardian_native_binary_digest_invalid:$($file.Name)" }

+function Assert-Sha256([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
+  if ($Value -notmatch '^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$') { throw "${Label}_sha256_invalid" }
+  return $Value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
+}
+
+function Wait-ProcessGone([int]$ProcessId, [int]$Seconds, [string]$Label) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds([Math]::Max(1, $Seconds))
+  do {
+    if (-not (Get-Process -Id $ProcessId -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { return }
+    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
+  } while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline)
+  throw "${Label}_still_alive:$ProcessId"
+}
+
+function Get-ExactExecutableProcesses([string]$Executable) {
+  $target = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Executable)
+  $targetName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($target).Replace("'", "''")
+  $rows = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = '$targetName'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
+  return @($rows | Where-Object {
+    $candidate = [string]$_.ExecutablePath
+    if (-not $candidate) { return $false }
+    try {
+      return [System.StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase.Equals(
+        [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($candidate),
+        $target
+      )
+    } catch {
+      return $false
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+function Wait-ExactExecutableProcessesGone([string]$Executable, [int]$Seconds, [string]$Label) {
+  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds([Math]::Max(1, $Seconds))
+  do {
+    $rows = @(Get-ExactExecutableProcesses $Executable)
+    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { return }
+    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
+  } while ([DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline)
+
+  $remaining = @(Get-ExactExecutableProcesses $Executable)
+  $diagnostics = @($remaining | ForEach-Object {
+    [ordered]@{
+      pid = [int]$_.ProcessId
+      parent_pid = [int]$_.ParentProcessId
+      executable_path = [string]$_.ExecutablePath
+      command_line = [string]$_.CommandLine
+    }
+  })
+  Write-Host ($diagnostics | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress)
+  throw "${Label}_exact_path_processes_still_alive:$($remaining.Count)"
+}

+function Read-JsonProbe([string]$Executable, [string]$Argument, [bool]$WriteProfileMarker = $false) {

+  $out = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "browser-probe-$stem.out"
+  $err = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "browser-probe-$stem.err"

+    if ($WriteProfileMarker) { $env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE = '1' }
+    else { Remove-Item Env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $Executable -ArgumentList $Argument -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err

+      try { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+      throw "probe_timeout:$Argument"
+    }
+    if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) {
+      Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Write-Host
+      throw "probe_exit_$($p.ExitCode):$Argument"
+    }
+  } finally {
+    if ($null -eq $priorProfileWrite) { Remove-Item Env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+    else { $env:METAENGINE_PROFILE_PROBE_WRITE = $priorProfileWrite }
+  }
+  $line = Get-Content $out | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1
+  if (-not $line) { throw "probe_output_missing:$Argument" }
+  return ($line | ConvertFrom-Json)
